disclaimer: Simplified estimate using the 2024 salary tax brackets (Executive Decree No. 44276-H). Costa Rica uses a TERRITORIAL tax system: only Costa Rica-sourced income is taxed, for residents and non-residents alike; foreign-sourced income is fully exempt regardless of residency, which this calculator does not model (it assumes all entered salary is Costa Rica-sourced). Salary paid in cash to non-residents on the local payroll uses these SAME brackets, so no separate non-resident regime is needed here — the residency distinction mainly affects foreign income and benefits paid 'in kind' (which use a flat 15% rate not modeled here). CCSS social security contributions and tax credits for children/spouse are not included.

regimes.label: Salary Tax (2024)
regimes.notes: Annualized from the official 2024 monthly salary-tax brackets. Applies to both residents and non-residents earning Costa Rica-sourced salary.
